error_boundary_description:
This should obviously not happen. Very sorry Giới thiệu this.
If you have a phút, please report this on GitHub, or let us know via Discord or Matrix.
error_boundary_unsupported_indexeddb_des:
The ntfy web app needs IndexedDB to function, and your browser does not support IndexedDB in riêng tư browsing mode.

While this is unfortunate, it also doesn't really make a lot of sense to use the ntfy web app in riêng tư browsing mode anyway, because everything is stored in the browser storage. You can read more Giới thiệu it in this GitHub issue, or talk to us on Discord or Matrix.
